goal: Deliver a Human MCP onboarding and diagnostics experience that improves Agent bootstrap while keeping all authorization in existing WorkMesh API/domain boundaries.

authorityModel.humanPrincipal: A Human creates and owns an Agent Connection; this does not create an Agent Session or grant work authority.
authorityModel.pairingFragment: A single-use, expiring connection bootstrap value held only in the URL fragment and browser memory; it is not a bearer credential for work mutations.
authorityModel.installationIdentity: Redeeming the exact pairing flow activates one Agent installation identity and returns a credential that belongs only in the Agent secret store.
authorityModel.agentSession: Ordinary work mutations still require an active exact Agent Session and its scoped token, not the Human session or installation credential alone.
authorityModel.delegation: Delegation, approved Team access, capability scope, approval, lease, revision, and idempotency remain server-enforced and are never inferred from UI availability.
authorityModel.mcpBoundary: MCP delegates to REST/contracts and must not reproduce business policy, persist tokens, or mint authority from client configuration.

agentBootstrapChecklist: Fetch /.well-known/workmesh-agent and reject unsupported protocol/profile/Skill selectors.
Load the exact pinned WorkMesh Skill and verify SHA-256/signature metadata before pairing.
Redeem only the one-time pairing fragment within its expiry and store the returned installation credential only in the client secret store.
Call verify_connection and require exact Connection, Coordination Session, Team, principal Human, profile, Skill, and capability scope consistency.
Call get_workmesh_context before selecting work and never infer mutation authority from tool presence or Human UI state.
Stop on revoked, expired, mis-scoped, unsupported, feature-disabled, or inconsistent live facts.

generatedOrConditionalTargets.rule: If a required generated artifact, source generator, route-policy binding, OpenAPI contract, or shared UI export lies outside writeTargets, implementation must stop and version the graph/contract before writing it.

secretPolicy.evidenceRule: Use synthetic canaries and key-name/presence checks; do not read or print live secret values.

integration: pairing redeem/verify/revoke with synthetic fixture and deterministic cleanup
server restart or durable replay where applicable

browserContract.requestAudit: GET/OPTIONS plus only explicitly authorized fixture mutations; all mutation methods must bind exact Idempotency-Key, CSRF/authorization boundary, target, and cleanup receipt.

activation.compensation: Every mutation phase must produce a durable terminal receipt and restore exact v30 roles or retain authenticated old owners when failure occurs before cutover.
activation.activeFixture: One synthetic Agent Connection only: create, redeem plus verify_connection, and revoke/cleanup; never reuse a real credential or persist a token in evidence.

rejectedBoundaries: Human credential as Agent Session authority
client configuration containing a live token
Git mutation, GitHub CI, broad security scan, or unrelated refactor
knownLimitations: The contract is based on current source and live read-only facts; implementation must stop on any hidden generated-source or route-policy dependency outside the fixed target list.
A targeted secret/redaction test matrix is required, but no repository-wide security scan or security approval is claimed.
